[Act: technology
 Chapter: Schedules · The Schedules
 Section: first-schedule::The First Schedule 1
]


2[1. A negotiable instrument (other than a cheque, a Demand Promissory Note or a Bill of Exchange issued in favour of or endorsed by an entity regulated by the Reserve Bank of India, National Housing Bank, Securities and Exchange Board of India, Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India and Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority) as defined in Section 13 of the Negotiable Instrument Act, 1881 (26 of 1881).]
2.A power-of-attorney as defined in section 1A of the Powers-of-Attorney Act, 1882 (7 of 1882) 3[but excluding those power-of-attorney that empower an entity regulated by the Reserve Bank of India, National Housing Bank, Securities and Exchange Board of India, Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India and Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority to act for, on behalf of, and in the name of the person executing them.].
3.A trust as defined in section 3 of the Indian Trust Act, 1882 (2 of 1882).
4.A will as defined in clause (h) of section 2 of the Indian Succession Act, 1925 (39 of 1925), including any other testamentary disposition by whatever name called.
5.4[***]
Substituted by Act 10 of 2009, s. 49, for the First Schedule and the Second Schedule (w.e.f. 27-10-2009).
